# SkillSpector scan-input exclusions (WP-A, 2026-11-24).
# SkillSpector has NO --exclude / --ignore option (verified: `skillspector scan
# --help`, local 2.12.0; no .skillspector* config in the repo). These paths are
# therefore excluded by staging, not by the scanner: the workflow runs
# .github/scripts/stage_scan_source.py, which copies the checkout to a staging
# directory without them and scans the staging directory instead of `.`.
# Reason for every entry below: historical scan data / audit evidence, not
# runtime source. What is excluded is the SCAN INPUT, not the disposition: the
# 165 findings these files attracted in the 2026-11-24 rescan are dispositioned
# item by item in ~/workspace/aka-skills-review/wp-a-historical-165.md
# (HISTORICAL_DATA_REVIEWED). See docs/OPTIONAL_SKILLSPECTOR_POLICY.md.
# Scope: the full-source scan only. The deterministic package scan still
# contains these files (tools/release_package.py archives every committed
# blob); findings on them in the package scan are dispositioned by the same
# WP-A file, not by exclusion.
# Rules: one path pattern per line, relative to the repo root, fnmatch syntax.
# A pattern ending in "/" excludes the whole directory. Every pattern must
# match at least one path or the staging script fails closed.
security-findings.json
docs/evidence/
docs/TRIAGE-2026-11-24.md
.github/scan-exclusions.txt
.github/scripts/stage_scan_source.py
# Any further human-readable triage summary placed under docs/ must be added
# here as an exact path before the next rescan; until then it is NOT excluded
# and will be scanned.
